name: Dr. Elena Vasquez
bio: Associate Professor of Pure Mathematics at MIT. Elena's research focuses on algebraic geometry and number theory. She has published over forty papers and is a recipient of the Sloan Research Fellowship. Her writing bridges the gap between rigorous mathematics and accessible exposition.

name: Prof. James Okafor
bio: James is a computational mathematician at Stanford specializing in numerical methods for PDEs and scientific computing. He leads the Applied Math & Computation Lab and has contributed to open-source spectral method libraries used worldwide.

name: Dr. Anika Patel
bio: Anika is a research scientist at DeepMind working at the intersection of mathematics and artificial intelligence. She holds a PhD in mathematical statistics from Cambridge and writes about the theoretical foundations of machine learning.
